newsitem.title: USA: AT&T eyes flat-rate calling plans - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: AT&T eyes flat-rate calling plans - WSJ.

text.p: AT&T Corp is drafting a flat-rate offer for all local, long-distance and in-state toll calls that could be as low as 15 cents per minute, the Wall Street Journal reported Thursday.
The calling rate would be effective regardless of the day of the week or time of day, and might eventually be offered to cellular phone users, the article said.
The plan comes as part of the company's efforts to finish its repositioning after announcing its three-way breakup last year.
